# rwa CLI

CLI for trading tokenized stocks & ETFs (Ondo Global Markets) on Solana via Jupiter.
438 tokens: TSLA, AAPL, NVDA, SPY, QQQ, and more.

## Install

Preferred:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/outputlayer/rwa_cli/main/install.sh | sh
```

The installer downloads a pre-built binary from GitHub Releases when available and falls back to building from source. It verifies the download's SHA-256 checksum and fails closed (exit 1) if verification is impossible (missing manifest, no matching checksum entry, no sha256sum/shasum tool) — `RWA_INSTALL_INSECURE=1` is an explicit unrecommended bypass.

From source:

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/outputlayer/rwa_cli --bin rwa
```

## Critical agent rules

- NEVER run `rwa` wallet-changing commands in parallel processes or with `&`
- Fund a wallet with USDC only: trading works on gasless routes, and the CLI auto-buys SOL when it runs low (dynamic 5-25 USDC: ~50 txs + 5 ATAs at live fees, x2 buffer) (reported as `gas_refuel` in the JSON output; disable with RWA_NO_AUTO_GAS=1)
- Multi-token calls (baskets, close-all) run in parallel by default — safe (bounded internally) and fast; `--sequential` is the rate-limit fallback. Parallel quotes are staggered (`RWA_QUOTE_STAGGER_MS`, default 350ms) and **adaptive**: once Jupiter starts throttling (retries climb), remaining launches widen to a serial pace so a keyless wallet degrades gracefully instead of retry-storming. a configured `RWA_JUPITER_API_KEY` auto-selects the keyed profile (stagger 0, quote concurrency 4 vs 2) — no manual tuning; `RWA_QUOTE_STAGGER_MS` still overrides
- Use `sleep 3` between sequential commands only (not needed with built-in parallel flags)
- Always use `--json` for machine-readable output
- Use `-y` only for real execution, not for `--dry-run`
- `--json` without `-y` NEVER executes the six gated money-moving commands (buy, sell, send, buy-basket, sell-basket, close-all): it fails closed instead of running non-interactively. The guarantee is "never executes" — an otherwise-valid invocation returns `error_kind: confirmation_required` (exit 1, not transient), but a precondition failure surfaces its own kind first (`insufficient_funds`, `no_position`, `amount_below_minimum`, …), and `close-all` on an empty wallet returns `status:success` (nothing to sell). So DON'T assume `--json`-without-`-y` always yields `confirmation_required`; treat any non-`confirmation_required` error as the real precondition problem. `reclaim` reclaims rent to your own wallet and runs without confirmation. This also gates auto-gas refuel — with `--json` alone (no `-y`), refuel is skipped silently rather than auto-approved. Add `-y` to execute, or `--dry-run` to preview.
- There is no `quote` command; use `buy/sell --dry-run`
- `send` transfers assets to another wallet; `sell` swaps for USDC
- CLI auto-retries swap failures; do NOT manually retry them

## Commands

### Market info
- `rwa --json gm hours` — current session + tradable count, plus optional `offhours_tradable_count`/`paused_count` (24/7 flagship set size, and `paused_count` = tokens Ondo flags paused now — dividend windows PLUS, on weekends, most non-24/7 tokens; absent if asset metadata fetch fails)
- `rwa --json gm hours --tradable` — all tokens tradable right now, plus `offhours_tradable` (the flagship symbols)
- `rwa --json gm list` — all tokens with tradable status
- `rwa --json gm search --search <keyword>` — filter by symbol, name, or sector
- `rwa --json gm search --tradable-only --sector <SECTOR> --type <stock|etf> --name-keyword <WORD>` — bulk filtering without Python
- `rwa --json gm tradable [SYM ...]` — tradable lookup for one, many, or all tokens

### Trading
- `rwa --json gm buy <SYM> <AMT> --dry-run` — preview buy
- `rwa --json gm buy <SYM> <AMT> --quote-only` — quote any size without a balance check; never executes (rejects `-y`), still enforces market hours + slippage. JSON `status` is `dry_run` (same shape as `--dry-run`). Use to size a trade before funding.
- `rwa --json gm buy/sell <SYM> <AMT> --max-bps <N>` — reject the trade if quoted all-in cost (spread+fee) > N bps; returns `error_kind: cost_too_high`. `RWA_MAX_BPS` sets a global default. Works in `--dry-run` as a cost check. Also accepted by `buy-basket`/`sell-basket`/`close-all` (over-budget items land in `failed[]` with `error_kind: cost_too_high`), as is `--slippage <BPS>`.
- `rwa --json gm buy/sell <SYM> <AMT> --limit-price <P> [share|token]` — conditional trade: executes only if the quote's implied price (USDC/token) is <= P for buy, >= P for sell (equality passes); otherwise fails with `error_kind: condition_not_met` (exit 1, not transient) — same in `--dry-run`. The gated quote executes as-is, so worst-case fill is limit +/- slippage tolerance. Price is per RAW token by default; canonical form gives the unit as a space-separated second word (e.g. `--limit-price 748 share`) to gate per underlying share via the mint's scaled-UI multiplier instead — the raw threshold then floats with dividend accrual (intended); requires reading the multiplier, so RPC failure fails closed with exit 75. Joined forms (`748share`, `748:share`, `share748`, ...) still work; `token` accepted for explicitness (bare number = token, same as `token`). Conflicts with `--quote-only`. JSON echoes `limit_price` (space-joined when given as two words). Synthetic limit order: schedule it (cron/loop) every N minutes until it exits 0, e.g. `rwa gm buy TSLA 100 --limit-price 400 --slippage 20 -y --json`. DCA is plain scheduled `buy -y` (no limit); stop-loss is an external reference-price check + market `sell -y`, not `--limit-price`. Real `-y` runs on low-SOL wallets may auto-refuel gas (USDC→SOL) before the condition check, bounded and disabled by RWA_NO_AUTO_GAS=1.
- `rwa --json gm buy <SYM> <AMT> -y` — execute buy
- `rwa --json gm sell <SYM> <AMT> --dry-run` — preview sell
- `rwa --json gm sell <SYM> <AMT> -y` — execute sell (amounts are raw-frame; for dividend-accruing tokens, overflow error names both raw and wallet-displayed balance; prefer `all`/`NN%`)
- `rwa --json gm close-all --dry-run` — preview liquidation
- Trade JSON `router`/`gasless` are optional: absent = Jupiter's quote didn't report them (AMM routes), NOT false. RWA_EXCLUDE_ROUTERS=jupiterz,iris,dflow forces AMM routes (~1.3s vs ~5s RFQ) at the cost of gasless + tighter RFQ pricing; AMM liquidity is not guaranteed off Regular hours
- `rwa --json gm search --tag <label>` — filter by any Ondo tag (asset class, region, factor: asia, dividend, "fixed income"); items carry optional asset_class/region
- `rwa --json gm pnl` — avg entry price, realized/unrealized P&L (from CLI trades only; deposits ignored); JSON always carries `ledger_integrity`: `"ok"` | `"legacy"` (pre-chain entries, unbroken) | `"broken@line N"` (tamper/corruption detected) — a broken chain warns on stderr (human mode only; in `--json` the signal is the `ledger_integrity` field itself) but never fails the command
- `rwa --json gm close-all -y` — sell all positions (parallel by default)
- `rwa --json keys export --reveal` — private key + recovery phrase JSON (SECRET; --reveal is mandatory)
- `rwa --json gm close-all --sequential -y` — one-at-a-time with 3s spacing (only if rate-limited)
- `rwa --json gm close-all 50% -y` — sell a percentage of every position
- `rwa --json gm buy-basket <SYM AMT ...> --dry-run` — preview basket buy quotes (SYMBOL AMOUNT pairs)
- `rwa --json gm buy-basket <SYM AMT ...> -y` — buy multiple tokens (parallel by default; `--sequential` if rate-limited)
- `rwa --json gm buy-basket <SYM PCT% ...> --total <USDC> -y` — split one USDC total by percent weights (weights must sum to exactly 100; every item ≥ 5 USDC; JSON echoes `allocation: {total, weights}`)
- `rwa --json gm sell-basket <SYM AMT ...> --dry-run` — preview basket sell quotes
- `rwa --json gm sell-basket <SYM AMT ...> -y` — sell multiple tokens (parallel by default; `--sequential` if rate-limited)

### Portfolio & history
- `rwa --json gm portfolio` — own wallet holdings
- `rwa --json gm portfolio <WALLET>` — any public wallet
- `rwa --json gm history <SYM>` — price history (default `1M`)
- `rwa --json gm history <SYM> -r 1D` — 1D/1W/1M/3M/1Y/ALL

`portfolio` uses a stable nested JSON contract:
- `cash.sol`
- `cash.usdc`
- `gm_positions.positions[]`
- `gm_positions.value_usd`
- `gm_positions.change_24h_usd`
- `gm_positions.change_24h_pct`

Do not rely on legacy flat `portfolio` fields.

GM tokens are total-return trackers (Token-2022 Scaled UI): dividends accrue via the mint's multiplier, so token price = share price × multiplier and wallet balances = raw × multiplier. The CLI's canonical frame is RAW everywhere (amounts, prices, ledger, pnl). `portfolio` values each position as raw × price and adds `shares_per_token` per position; `buy`/`sell` previews (including `--quote-only`/`--dry-run`) add `share_price`. Both `share_price` and `shares_per_token` are informational only (never the trade input/output) and are only present when the multiplier != 1 (omitted for ordinary 1:1 mints).

### Transfers
- `rwa --json gm send SOL <AMT> <TO> --dry-run` — preview SOL transfer
- `rwa --json gm send SOL all <TO> -y` — drain SOL (auto-reserves tx fee)
- `rwa --json gm send USDC <AMT> <TO> --dry-run` — preview USDC transfer
- `rwa --json gm send USDC all <TO> -y` — drain USDC with full precision
- `rwa --json gm send <TOKEN> <AMT> <TO> -y` — send GM token

### Maintenance
- `rwa --json gm reclaim` — close empty token accounts, reclaim SOL rent
- `rwa --json gm reclaim --token <SYM>` — reclaim one token only
- `rwa --json update --check` — report if a newer release exists (status `up_to_date` | `update_available`)
- `rwa --json update -y` — self-update to latest (verifies SHA-256, fail-closed)

### Wallet
- `rwa keys generate` — create wallet (encrypted by default; `--allow-plaintext` to opt out). With `--json` returns `{status, pubkey, path, encrypted, mnemonic}` — capture `mnemonic`: for plaintext wallets it is shown only this once. `keys import`/`keys add --json` return the same shape without `mnemonic` (`add` also carries `name`/`active`; registering an existing .age file leaves `pubkey` null)
- `rwa keys import --seed-phrase "word1 word2 ..."` — import mnemonic (default path m/44'/501'/0'/0'). Add `--account <N>` (→ m/44'/501'/N'/0', Phantom "Account N+1") or `--derivation-path "<PATH>"` (mutually exclusive) to import a non-default account; a non-default path warns that the phrase alone restores account 0 — record the path
- `rwa keys import --private-key <BASE58>` — import private key
- `rwa keys show` — show address + key path
- `rwa keys encrypt` — convert `key.json` -> `key.age`
- `rwa keys decrypt` — convert `key.age` -> `key.json`
- `rwa keys add <NAME> --path <PATH>` — register an existing key file by name; with `--seed-phrase "..."` or `--private-key <KEY>` it imports the key to `<PATH>` (encrypted by default; `--allow-plaintext` to opt out) and registers it
- `rwa keys list` — list named wallets (* = active); `--json` returns `{wallets:[{name,path,pubkey,active,encrypted}]}`
- `rwa keys use <NAME>` — set the active wallet
- `rwa keys remove <NAME>` — unregister (key file is NOT deleted)
- `rwa --wallet <NAME> gm <CMD>` — select a named wallet for one command; wallet selection priority: `--wallet` / `RWA_WALLET` > registry `active` > legacy `key.json`/`key.age`

## Amount formats

- Exact: `100`
- Percentage: `50%`
- All: `all`

Inputs with too many decimal places are rejected instead of being silently rounded.

## Trading sessions (ET)

- Pre-Market: 4:00 AM – 9:29 AM
- Regular: 9:30 AM – 3:59 PM
- Post-Market: 4:00 PM – 7:59 PM
- Overnight: 8:00 PM – 3:59 AM
- Closed: Weekend / NYSE holidays — Ondo off-hours; select flagship tokens (TSLAon, NVDAon, SPYon, QQQon, GOOGLon, ...) still trade 24/7

Not all tokens are tradable in every session. Use `gm tradable <SYM...>` for symbol checks, `gm tradable` for the full set, or filtered `gm search --tradable-only ...` for bulk scans.

## Bulk workflows

Check tradable + buy basket in 2 commands (most efficient):

```bash
# 1. Get all tradable healthcare stocks in one call
rwa --json gm search --tradable-only --sector Healthcare --type stock

# 2. Buy all tradable tokens at once — one command, parallel by default
rwa --json gm buy-basket JNJ 25 LLY 25 PFE 25 ABBV 25 -y
```

Jupiter API note:
- The CLI tries public Jupiter routes in this order: `lite-api.jup.ag/swap/v2` first, then `ultra-api.jup.ag`, then `lite-api.jup.ag/ultra/v1`, with `lite-api.jup.ag/swap/v1` as the final fallback.
- Route availability can differ by session, holiday calendar, and MM liquidity.
- Quote-fetch retries back off up to 3.2s per attempt within a ~20s budget per quote-fetch pass; a `still fetching quote (...)` heartbeat prints to stderr on each retry, so a slow quote is visible rather than a silent hang. Do not treat the heartbeat as an error.

Syntax for buy-basket and sell-basket: interleaved `SYMBOL AMOUNT` pairs. Each token gets its own amount. Parallel is the default; `--sequential` is the rate-limit fallback:

```bash
rwa --json gm buy-basket TSLA 100 AAPL 50 NVDA 25 -y            # different amounts
rwa --json gm sell-basket SPY 5 TSLA 3 NVDA all -y              # partial sells
rwa --json gm buy-basket TSLA 100 AAPL 50 --sequential -y       # if rate-limited
rwa --json gm buy-basket TSLA 50% NVDA 30% SPY 20% --total 1000 -y   # weighted allocation of one total
```

IMPORTANT for baskets and close-all: a partially failed run still exits 0 with `status: "success"` — the command completed; per-item outcomes live in `failed[]` (and close-all's `skipped[]`). ALWAYS inspect those arrays; do not gate on the exit code alone.

Full exit:

```bash
rwa --json gm close-all -y              # parallel by default (~22s); --sequential if rate-limited
rwa --json gm reclaim
rwa --json gm send USDC all <ADDR> -y
rwa --json gm send SOL all <ADDR> -y
```

## Parallel vs sequential

| Tokens | Sequential | Parallel | Speedup |
|--------|-----------|---------|--------|
| 4 | ~97s | ~22s | 4.4× |
| 6 | ~147s | ~22s | 6.7× |
| 10 | ~247s | ~22s | 11× |

Parallel is safe for different tokens. jupiterz routes through multiple MMs internally — if one MM returns a bad quote, the CLI retries to get a better one.

## Error handling

With `--json`, failures return `{"status":"error","error":"...","error_kind":...}` on stdout and exit code `1` (or `75` if transient).

- Exit code `2` = clap usage error (unknown/conflicting flags, missing args): NO JSON is emitted — human usage text goes to stderr. Fix the invocation; never retry as-is.
- Number policy: exact money fields (`amount`, `counter_amount`, `qty`, ledger units) are DECIMAL STRINGS — parse them as decimals, never floats. Informational prices/percentages (`share_price`, `slippage_pct`, `change_pct_24h`) are rounded JSON numbers.

- `confirmation_required` → `--json` was used without `-y` on a real (non-`--dry-run`) invocation of one of the six gated commands (buy, sell, send, buy-basket, sell-basket, close-all); add `-y` to execute or `--dry-run` to preview. `reclaim` reclaims rent to your own wallet and is never gated. Not transient — never retry as-is.
- `not_tradable` → skip token or check `list --search <SYM>`
- `amount_below_minimum` → buy below 5 USDC (single or basket item); raise the amount
- `insufficient_funds` → wallet lacks USDC, or the quoted route is not gasless and the wallet has no SOL (USDC-only wallets trade fine on gasless routes; send/reclaim always need SOL); fund the wallet, do not retry
- `no_position` → selling a token the wallet does not hold; check `portfolio` first
- `unknown_token` → symbol not in the GM list (typo?); find it with `search --search <keyword>`, do not retry as-is
- `invalid_amount` → amount failed to parse (bad format, too many decimals, bad percentage); amounts are a number, `NN%`, or `all`
- `invalid_address` / `self_send` → send recipient is not a valid Solana address / is the sender itself; fix the address
- `unknown_wallet` → `--wallet`/`RWA_WALLET` named an unregistered wallet; the message lists available names (`keys list`)
- `reveal_required` → `keys export --json` needs explicit `--reveal` (it prints SECRET material); retry with `--reveal` only if the user asked for the key
- `interactive_required` → admin command (keys export --reveal / keys decrypt) run without a TTY; user must type the passphrase interactively; env/keychain are not consulted for these operations
- `lock_contention` → another rwa process holds the exclusive lock; transient (exit 75) — wait and retry. Note: the lock covers EVERY rwa invocation including read-only ones, so serialize ALL rwa calls, not just wallet-changing ones
- Exit code 75 = transient (retry sensible: rpc_unavailable / execute_unavailable / confirmation_timeout / lock_contention); exit 1 = permanent
- `market_closed` → token does not trade off-hours; tell user when regular trading reopens (Sunday 8 PM ET) or suggest an off-hours flagship token
- `trading_paused` → Ondo has `is_trading_paused` set for this asset. TWO causes: (a) a dividend window (ex-dividend; longer for ETFs — resolves in hours/days), or (b) the market is closed for it (weekends/holidays flag most non-24/7 tokens paused; the paused check runs before the session check, so a weekend non-flagship reports `trading_paused` rather than `market_closed`). On buy/sell it's a hard error; close-all → `skipped[]`, baskets → `failed[]` with this kind; `list`/`search`/`tradable` may carry `"trading_paused":true`. Check `gm hours` (`next_session_at`) for when it resumes — don't hammer-retry a weekend pause; don't treat as `not_tradable`
- `No swap route` / `HTTP 400` → likely no liquidity or accidental parallel execution
- `slippage_too_high` → reduce size or skip token
- `confirmation_timeout` → tx may still land; check Solscan before retrying
- `on_chain_failure` → treat as real chain failure, not a preview issue
- `execute_unavailable` (swap) → Jupiter `/execute` was rate-limited/unavailable; the CLI already auto-retries with a fresh order. On repeats, set `RWA_JUPITER_API_KEY` for higher limits.
- `route_unfillable` (swap) → the quoted route would fail on-chain (RFQ MM can't fill) or the signed tx under-delivers vs its own quote beyond slippage tolerance; the CLI auto-refetches excluding that router. Surfaces only after retries are exhausted. Pin a persistently bad router with `RWA_EXCLUDE_ROUTERS=jupiterz` (comma-separated). Surfaces only for a genuinely unfillable route. RFQ makers fund fills just-in-time at `/execute` (mint in the same block), which pre-sign simulation can't see — so on a managed `/execute` route that funds JIT (gasless), a simulation that merely ERRORED is submitted anyway (Jupiter + on-chain min-output enforce honesty; stderr `note:`). This makes thin RFQ-only tokens (PFEon/LLYon) buyable from the CLI. Dishonest deltas on a SUCCESSFUL simulation, an unreachable RPC, or any Metis direct-submit failure are still hard-refused. Set `RWA_DEBUG=1` to restore the condensed simulation program-log and per-backend quote-failure detail.
- `rpc_unavailable` (also `Solana RPC ... unavailable` / `all RPC endpoints failed` / `HTTP 429` in error text) → public nodes are rate-limited; the CLI already retries transient errors and 429s with backoff. On repeated failures, wait a few seconds, or set `RWA_RPC_URL` to a dedicated endpoint (free API key from Alchemy/Helius/QuickNode/Chainstack/dRPC) — the canonical fix per Solana's own docs.
- `gm portfolio` auto-falls back to Jupiter Ultra holdings when Solana RPC is unavailable; the JSON gains `"source":"jupiter"` (absent on the normal RPC path).
